purpose: Bounded research weather transformation; not a joined ignition panel or operational forecast
input: CDS ERA5-Land 2025 Jan-Nov hourly pilot, five variables
timezone: Fixed UTC-5 standard noon for this Thunder Bay input; western Ontario would require a declared UTC-6 or verified local-standard-time mapping
fwi_startup: Research-only April1 FFMC85/DMC6/DC15; no snow/overwintering assertion
missingness: Missing hourly rainfall/required noon weather invalidates state; no implicit zero rainfall or restart
forecast_cutoff: For a 00:00 local calendar-day label, only a preceding weather noon is eligible; same-date noon is forbidden. Reanalysis is retrospective; no available-at-issue claim. No ignition join was built by this converter.
province_execution: Current implementation loads full hourly input arrays and loops cells; use on bounded pilot grids. Province processing needs chunking and timezone/state design before use.
